limitations: All newly curated facts are llm/unreviewed and not admitted Tier A records.

No region/marker overlap is used as same-cell or same-animal identity.
No doses, acoustic parameters, genetic sequences or procedural instructions are exported in graph facts.
A gene marker is an identity annotation, not an observed expression vector.
A no_change significance finding is not equivalence evidence.
Existing sonogenetic method-vocabulary gap remains explicit rather than silently rewriting derived perturbation classes.
measurement_unit: One study-specific population/intervention/readout observation per edge; projections are population→region observations.
